history.text: Portuguese sailors reached the Komo estuary.
The territory became part of French Equatorial Africa.
Thirteen national parks were created, covering about a tenth of the country.

worthSeeing.title: Loango National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Forest elephants, buffalo and hippos on Atlantic beaches.

worthSeeing.title: Ivindo National Park:
worthSeeing.text: The Kongou and Mingouli falls in dense rainforest.

worthSeeing.title: Lope National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Forest-savannah mosaic with archaeological sites, a UNESCO site.
